entities.summary: Gevorg "Giorgio" Petrosyan is an Armenian-Italian former kickboxer who competed in the middleweight division. Nicknamed "The Doctor", he is noted for supreme technical skills, ringsmanship, and defensive prowess which has seen him defeat some of the best strikers in the world while taking little damage. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest kickboxers of all time.
